summary.en: Drive to the outcrop, scan it, drill a sample, return to the lab, analyse and log it.
summary.ar: Drive to the outcrop, scan it, drill a sample, return to the lab, analyse and log it.

briefing.en: Science is a chain: context → scan → sample → analysis → record.
briefing.ar: Science is a chain: context → scan → sample → analysis → record.

briefing.en: A sample without context is just a rock.
briefing.ar: A sample without context is just a rock.

hint.en: Use the rover to reach Sample Site Alpha.
hint.ar: Use the rover to reach Sample Site Alpha.

hint.en: Park and step onto the outcrop.
hint.ar: Park and step onto the outcrop.

hint.en: Record layering, grain size and spectral hints before drilling.
hint.ar: Record layering, grain size and spectral hints before drilling.

title.en: Drill and seal a core sample
title.ar: Drill and seal a core sample

hint.en: Core drill plus a sterile sample container.
hint.ar: Core drill plus a sterile sample container.

success_message.en: Core sealed and labelled. Take it to the lab.
success_message.ar: Core sealed and labelled. Take it to the lab.

hint.en: Drive back and enter the pressurised lab.
hint.ar: Drive back and enter the pressurised lab.

hint.en: Run the spectrometer to get oxide composition.
hint.ar: Run the spectrometer to get oxide composition.

title.en: Log the finding in the science database
title.ar: Log the finding in the science database

hint.en: Write the interpretation with its source into the mission database.
hint.ar: Write the interpretation with its source into the mission database.

success_message.en: Finding logged with provenance and interpretation.
success_message.ar: Finding logged with provenance and interpretation.

hint.en: Optional: more science, more wear on the drill.
hint.ar: Optional: more science, more wear on the drill.

message.en: Drilling blind chips the bit and gives you a sample with no context.
message.ar: Drilling blind chips the bit and gives you a sample with no context.

message.en: There is nothing in the spectrometer chamber.
message.ar: There is nothing in the spectrometer chamber.

summary.en: Sample analysed and logged. The science database is now live.

reason.en: Drill badly worn by blind drilling.
reason.ar: Drill badly worn by blind drilling.

detail.en: The Martian crust is dominantly basaltic; olivine-rich and clay-bearing units record how much water altered the rock.
detail.ar: The Martian crust is dominantly basaltic; olivine-rich and clay-bearing units record how much water altered the rock.
